title: Mushroom Witch Apothecary
description: A hooded female figure with glowing blue eyes stands behind a wooden apothecary counter, holding an illuminated magical scroll. She is surrounded by oversized glowing mushrooms, hanging potion bottles, scattered scrolls, crystals, and mystical purple mist in a fantasy shop interior.
prompt: A mystical hooded witch with glowing blue skin and eyes stands in an enchanted apothecary, holding a glowing magical scroll with golden seals. Massive bioluminescent mushrooms with green and purple caps float above her, casting cyan light. Wooden counter covered in old scrolls, potion jars, crystals and herbs. Purple magical mist and sparkles fill the air, stained glass window in background, rich fantasy atmosphere, detailed digital painting
